jobs.description:
Do you enjoy coaching a team, solving customer issues and improving how things work?
 

For an international B2B company in 
Zaventem, MetiSelect is looking for a 
Customer Service Team Leader.
 

You will lead a team of 
four to five Customer Care colleagues and work closely with the Regional Business Manager. Alongside the daily team coordination, you will follow up on commercial agreements, prepare reports and help improve the service provided to customers and business partners.
 

You make sure your team knows what needs to happen, has the support to do it and follows customer requests through to completion.
 

Your responsibilities include the following.
 
 

•  

Lead and coach your team. Organise the workload, coordinate leave, support new colleagues and follow up on individual and team performance.
  

•  

Help resolve complex customer issues. Work with Sales, Finance and Supply Chain to find solutions and keep customers informed.
  

•  

Manage an existing partner relationship. Be the main operational contact for one business partner in Turkey, discussing open requests and coordinating follow-up internally.
  

•  

Follow up on commercial agreements. Keep track of pricing updates, contract deadlines, renewals and agreed discounts, working with the relevant colleagues in Sales, Finance and Legal.
  

•  

Use data to improve service. Prepare reports and maintain dashboards to monitor response times, open requests and commercial results.
  

•  

Improve processes. Investigate recurring problems and work with colleagues, including IT, to make workflows clearer and more efficient.
  

•  

Support the use of Salesforce. Help maintain accurate customer information and, as you become familiar with the system, support colleagues with questions and consistent ways of working.
  
 

•  

You have experience in 
B2B customer service, sales support, order management or commercial operations. You enjoy helping people develop while staying involved in the daily work.
  

•  

You bring 
at least five years of relevant experience, including experience directly managing a team.
  

•  

You have coached colleagues, set priorities and followed up on their performance.
  

•  

You understand how customer requests, commercial agreements and internal processes connect.
  

•  

You are comfortable using 
Excel, reports and KPIs to identify problems and decide what needs attention.
  

•  

You have worked with an 
ERP system, such as SAP or Dynamics. 
Salesforce experience is a strong advantage. Training can be considered if your wider experience fits the role.
  

•  

You communicate confidently in 
professional English. German or Italian is a plus.
  

•  

You take initiative, keep track of commitments and involve the right people to get things resolved.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Start as an experienced order picker on the permanent night shift at Kuehne+Nagel in Tessenderlo!

As an experienced order picker on the permanent night shift, you will join the team handling the exclusive toy department at Kuehne+Nagel in Tessenderlo. During the night shift, you will oversee the accurate processing, quality control and preparation for shipment of outgoing goods. Thanks to your logistics experience, night-time operations run smoothly, ensuring every order is ready for transport on time.

Our AI agent will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few questions and verify that you meet the job's minimum requirements. A consultant will always review your application and determine the next steps. If you have questions about this screening process, please contact us by applying for this vacancy or by reaching out to your nearest Randstad office.

Ready to start a long-term role? Call 011 54 92 85 or email talentcenter1@randstad.be!

VG 458/BUOSAP

• You have at least 6 months of experience as an order picker in a warehouse or distribution environment.
• You have a good command of Dutch or English to correctly follow safety and work instructions.
• You are physically fit, energetic, and looking for a long-term position on a permanent night shift.
• You have access to your own transport to reach the site in Tessenderlo independently (public transport is not an option).

Your responsibilities as an order picker:

• Picking orders using a handheld scanner or voice-picking system.
• Thoroughly checking product codes, quantities, and packaging quality.
• Carefully packing and preparing goods for shipment in accordance with strict guidelines.
• Monitoring stock levels and immediately reporting any discrepancies.
• Operating internal transport equipment (such as an electric pallet truck) and maintaining a safe, orderly work environment.

To support the continued growth of our Trademark & Design practice, we are looking for a highly skilled Senior Trademark & Design Attorney / Legal Counsel to join our team.
 

This position offers the opportunity to work on a broad range of trademark, design and related intellectual property matters for Belgian and international clients, ranging from innovative start-ups to multinational corporations.

About the job
 
 

• Advising clients ranging from innovative start-ups to multinational companies on trademark, design and related IP matters. 

• Managing national, European and international trademark and design portfolios. 

• Conducting trademark clearance searches and providing availability opinions. 

• Drafting, filing and prosecuting trademark and design applications before the BOIP, EUIPO, WIPO and foreign intellectual property offices. 

• Handling opposition, cancellation and invalidity proceedings. 

• Advising on infringement, unfair competition and IP enforcement strategies. 

• Drafting legal opinions, cease-and-desist letters, coexistence agreements, assignments, licence agreements, collaboration and R&D agreements. 

• Assisting clients in developing and implementing pragmatic IP protection strategies. 

• Liaising with clients, foreign associates and intellectual property offices worldwide. 

• Actively managing and developing a client base. 

• Monitoring legislative and case law developments and translating these into practical advice and trainings for clients. 

• Working closely with a team of experienced attorneys, legal professionals and paralegals.  

Your profile
 
 

• Education: Master's degree in Law, preferably with an additional qualification in Intellectual Property. 

• Experience: At least 5 years of experience in IP law and/or trademark and design protection, preferably in private practice. 

• Languages: Excellent written and oral communication skills in Dutch and English; other languages are a plus. 

• Mindset: Pragmatic, proactive, client-oriented, and self-motivated. 

• Skills: Attention to detail, ability to handle confidential cases discreetly, and strong prioritization skills. 

• Teamwork: Ability to work both individually and seamlessly within a team.

jobs.occupation: CONTENT CREATOR BEAUTY AND LIFESTYLE – NL/FR/ENG (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Deluge is seeking a creative and hands-on Content Creator to strengthen our brand presence and tell our story across digital channels. 
 

 As our Content Creator, you will:

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

Profile

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Analyst – BPMN & Stakeholder Management
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Identify and structure business requirements even when they are implicit, incomplete, or ambiguous.
• Facilitate workshops to guide stakeholders toward clear decision-making and requirements stabilization.
• Model AS-IS and TO-BE business processes using BPMN standards to identify improvement opportunities.
• Translate business needs into formal user stories, acceptance criteria, and wireframes.
• Collaborate closely with technical teams and functional analysts to ensure solutions align with business objectives.

Requirements

• 8+ years in Business Analysis including the independent management of complex analysis tracks.
• 8+ years in Stakeholder Management and Facilitation within expert-driven environments.
• 5+ years in Business Process Modeling using BPMN and requirement traceability.
• 5+ years experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, including User Stories and Acceptance Criteria.
• You have a strong understanding of ICT environments to evaluate the impact of technical choices.
• You bring advanced leadership skills to drive convergence and meet project deadlines.
• You possess strong analytical skills and the ability to challenge business requests critically.
• You are Native Dutch or Native French with good knowledge of the second language and active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Functional Analysis.
• Proven experience in creating wireframes or mock-ups to validate requirements.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain modern software solutions using the .NET framework.
• Perform technical analysis and translate business needs into robust application code.
• Collaborate closely with architects and analysts to ensure alignment with development standards.
• Execute testing, integration, and support activities for business-critical systems.
• Implement scalable and maintainable solutions in a fast-paced agile environment.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in backend development with .NET 8 and .NET 10.
• You bring extensive expertise in building applications with both WPF and Blazor.
• You possess strong knowledge of SQL, MongoDB, and RabbitMQ.
• You're experienced in developing and integrating REST API services.
• You bring proficiency in Azure DevOps and SEQ.
• You possess good communication skills and take accountability for your tasks.
• You are fluent in English with a good level of Dutch and/or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with SignalR.

jobs.occupation: Senior IT Project Manager – Application Delivery & Azure DevOps
jobs.description:

• Optimize the application development lifecycle, coordinating activities from analysis through to deployment and go-live.

• You bring 5+ years of experience in Team Leadership and people management within a technical environment.
• You have 5+ years of experience managing the Application Development Lifecycle (SDLC), specifically in environments combining projects and maintenance.
• You possess 3+ years of experience working with Azure DevOps for project tracking and coordination.
• You have a strong technical background in Application Architectures to effectively challenge technical proposals.
• You're analytically strong with a proactive approach to risk identification and escalation.
• You're an effective communicator capable of bridging the gap between business and IT stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch and French with an active knowledge of English.

• Knowledge of .NET, C#, and SQL.
• Experience with APIs and CI/CD environments.

jobs.occupation: BizTalk/ .Net Developer - in Neder-Over-Heembeek - for AMP (Bpost Company)
jobs.description:
BizTalk- and .Net Development
   
• Design, develop, and maintain integrations using Microsoft BizTalk Server 2020 and C#/.NET.  
• Develop and maintain schemas, maps, orchestrations, pipelines, ports, and adapter configurations.  
• Build and maintain .NET components and services, as well as REST and SOAP integrations; work extensively with XML, XSD, XSLT, and JSON.  
• Write and optimize SQL Server queries and stored procedures, implementing validation, error-handling, and logging mechanisms.  
• Translate business requirements into technical solutions in close collaboration with business analysts and application owners.  
Daily Operational Support
   
• Monitor interface performance and application health; analyze failed data exchanges, suspended messages, and processing delays.  
• Manage daily support requests and production incidents, prioritizing according to business impact and keeping users informed of progress.  
• Diagnose issues related to BizTalk, .NET, SQL Server, and connected systems, and coordinate resolutions with IT teams and external partners.  
• Safely restore processing operations, including controlled message resubmission, and perform root cause analysis to prevent recurring incidents.  
• Maintain and update support procedures, operational runbooks, and incident records; transform recurring issues into sustainable improvements.  
Quality and Deployment
   
• Test integrations and .NET developments, including error scenarios, and contribute to code reviews.  
• Manage source code in Git and participate in deployments, considering environment-specific configurations and rollback procedures.  
• Document interfaces and technical changes and ensure knowledge sharing with colleagues and relevant teams. 
  
• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in software development, including proven experience in the development and support of Microsoft BizTalk and C#/.NET solutions, preferably with BizTalk Server 2020.  
• Excellent knowledge of C# and the .NET Framework, with hands-on experience using Visual Studio.  
• Good understanding of BizTalk messaging, routing, promoted properties, mappings (maps), orchestrations, and pipelines.  
• Experience with XML/XSD, XSLT, JSON, REST/SOAP services, and adapters such as SFTP and WCF-SQL.  
• Strong knowledge of SQL Server and experience troubleshooting integration or application incidents in a production environment.  
• Experience using Git, performing testing activities, and working with structured deployment processes.  
• Willingness and ability to combine development activities with day-to-day application support.  
• Demonstrated experience using AI tools in software development, such as coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation.  
• You are able to critically evaluate generated outputs and consistently adhere to data confidentiality requirements.  
• Strong analytical mindset and a methodical approach to investigating and resolving incidents and technical issues.  
• Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to manage tasks from start to finish while maintaining clear communication and a continuous focus on business needs.  
• Ability to manage priorities efficiently, even under pressure, and collaborate effectively with colleagues while documenting solutions in a clear and structured manner.  
• Comfortable working both independently with a colleague and within multidisciplinary teams, actively contributing to collaboration and knowledge sharing.  
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to adapt your message to both technical and business-oriented stakeholders.  
• Able to remain effective under pressure while maintaining focus on organizational priorities and business requirements.  
• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good practical knowledge of English.  
• Nice to have:    o Experience with Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management) or cloud integration platforms.    o Experience working in a logistics, postal, transportation, or high-volume transaction processing environment.    o Familiarity with IT service management frameworks such as ITIL.    o Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools used for application and integration support.
